Research programme · 03

Model Security: Local LLMs & Trustworthy Agents

How can locally deployed models and agents be evaluated, aligned, and controlled before they act?

Safety for LLMs and agentic systems, spanning local and private deployment, jailbreak robustness, alignment, and repeatable evaluation harnesses.

Research focus

Three questions shape this programme.

This is the working agenda: a precise statement of the problems the lab is building toward, not a claim that every component is already solved.

01

Local & private deployment

Design model adaptation and operating patterns that keep sensitive workloads closer to their owners.

02

Robust alignment

Stress-test preferences, prompts, and safety policies under adversarial or noisy feedback.

03

Agent evaluation harnesses

Build repeatable tests around tools, memory, plans, and failure recovery before agentic systems are deployed.
